text:
Essen’s median asking rent sits at 9.7 €/m² in June 2026, up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 26.1 % over the last five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive markets. The premium over existing rents is 44 % (6.72 €/m²), while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 582 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 13.5 %.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.6 % and listings spend an average of 32 days on market; 21 % are let within a week, indicating moderate tightness but still affordable relative to income.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 10.24 €/m² for the next 12 months, ranging between 9.97 €/m² and 10.38 €/m², a 5.5 % increase.
